baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِن زَقُّومٍ joins eating, a tree-source, and zaqqum in one intake construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A tree ordinarily supplies edible yield, but the terminal zaqqum branch supplies an unpleasant bolus forced to the throat; nourishment is inverted without ceasing to be ingestion.

activation_trace.role: Taking food supplies the literal intake operation and keeps the model bodily.
Tree and crop yield supplies the expected food-producing relation that the object reverses.
The stalked tree supplies the material source from which the eaters must take.
Forcing or gulping an unpleasant thing to the throat converts food-taking into coerced passage.

changed_reading.before: They will eat from a named punitive tree.
changed_reading.after: They must perform nourishment with material whose defining motion is an unpleasant forced swallow, so the food-system defeats its own nourishing function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَجَرٍ and زَقُّومٍ sit inside the eating construction, while their branches expose the jaw-space and throat as successive locations.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tree image doubles as the opening between the jaws; eating initiates transfer there, and zaqqum completes it at the throat. The external plant is overlaid by the anatomy through which it passes.

activation_trace.role: Eating provides the transfer that links mouth-space to throat.
The space between the jaws and the opening of the mouth relocates the tree image onto the intake aperture.
Delivery to the throat supplies the second stage of the same anatomical conduit.

changed_reading.before: A person reaches outward to eat from a tree.
changed_reading.after: The tree also maps the eater's opened jaw-space, and its produce becomes a forced mouth-to-throat transit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human eating verb carries a fire-consuming branch beside a literal tree and a forced swallow.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because fire can 'eat' fuel, the grammar permits a role-reversal echo: humans eat the tree, yet the tree is also what fire eats, making their intake a possible entry into combustion rather than ordinary digestion.

activation_trace.role: Feeding and flaring fire supplies the nonhuman eating operation that makes agency reversible.
The stalked tree supplies plant material that can function as fuel while remaining the grammatical food-source.
The forced throatward motion places the possible fuel inside the human eater.

changed_reading.before: The subjects consume a hostile plant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they ingest what fire consumes and become the interior site of a fuel-consuming process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Penetrating hot wind, hot water, coal-black smoke, failed shade, and denied coolness turn the focus tree from merely hostile food into plausible fuel within an enveloping thermal system.

activation_trace.role: Fire eating fuel supplies the focus-side operation that the thermal context strengthens.
The literal tree supplies combustible plant matter at the center of the model.
A penetrating hot wind makes heat an invasive medium rather than a distant backdrop.
Hot water extends the thermal medium into what would normally cool or restore the body.
Blackness, coal, and smoke supply the material atmosphere of combustion.
Shade supplies the expected protective cover whose local form fails to protect.
Coolness as heat's opposite is explicitly negated, closing the route to thermal relief.

structural_cues: 56:42-44 surrounds the later tree meal with heat, dark cover, and a double failure of relief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invasive heat, hot liquid, smoke-black cover, no coolness, and a tree eaten in 56:52; I supply the arrow from tree-as-food to tree-as-fuel inside the eater. The ordinary punitive-meal reading remains live.

changed_reading.before: The fire-eating branch was a focus-only lexical echo.
changed_reading.after: The local thermal enclosure makes the eater/fuel reversal a coherent secondary mechanism: the humans take combustible tree matter into the very system that burns them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Formerly unrestrained ease and persistent breach recode eating as reciprocity: an appetite once released into consumption is answered by an allotted intake whose throatward movement is compulsory.

activation_trace.role: An edible share or provision frames the meal as an assigned portion rather than free choice.
Consumption and taking wealth supplies the prior appetite-pattern that can be turned back on the eater.
Forced swallowing removes the liberty that characterized the earlier appetite.
Expansive ease that releases its possessor supplies the earlier condition of unrestrained appetite.
Persistence and resolve make the earlier pattern sustained rather than incidental.
Sin and constriction mark the persisted condition as culpable and prepare a consequential reversal.

structural_cues: The causal account in 56:45-46 precedes the direct address and emphatic eating statement in 56:51-52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies released luxury, persistence in culpability, consumption branches, and a forced swallow; I infer a reversal from self-directed appetite to imposed appetite. A simpler causal sequence of offense then punishment remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces a generic punitive meal.
changed_reading.after: The punishment commandeers consumption itself: those formed by released appetite receive a compulsory counter-provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Loss of life and reduction to earth are answered by rousing and regathering at an appointed time; the immediate eating statement then demonstrates restored embodiment through a concrete metabolic act.

activation_trace.role: Literal food-taking supplies an enacted bodily capacity after the disputed resurrection.
Throatward swallowing makes the restored body anatomically specific rather than abstract.
Departure of force and life supplies the bodily discontinuity posed by the deniers.
Earth and dust supply the body's dispersed material state.
Rousing what was still supplies the reversal from bodily arrest to activity.
Joining the dispersed into a collected whole supplies reconstitution before eating.
An appointed meeting-time makes the reconstitution a scheduled event rather than a vague possibility.

structural_cues: The resurrection question in 56:47 is answered by gathering in 56:49-50 and then by direct bodily predicates beginning in 56:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death, dust, rousing, regathering, and then eating; I treat the eating as enacted proof of restored embodiment, while the materially live alternative is that it is only the next chronological punishment.

changed_reading.before: Eating follows resurrection as one punishment among others.
changed_reading.after: Eating is also the first concrete demonstration that the dispersed deniers have been reassembled as functioning, vulnerable bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Eating leads to vessel-level belly filling, then aversive hot drinking, then thirst that cannot be quenched; the sequence is finally labeled prepared guest-provision and reckoning. Intake reaches capacity but never reaches satisfaction.

activation_trace.role: Food-taking starts the intake cycle.
The unpleasant forced swallow gives the cycle its coercive entry condition.
Filling to the measure of a vessel makes bodily capacity, not nourishment, the eating goal.
The belly's fullness or illness identifies the body as the affected container.
Liquid taken with aversion extends compulsory intake beyond the solid meal.
Hot water turns the expected remedy for thirst into an aggravating continuation.
Unquenchable thirst prevents fullness from closing the intake cycle.
Prepared provision for a guest labels the punitive sequence as inverted hospitality.
Reckoning and recompense assign the anti-banquet its consequential function.

structural_cues: Consecutive participles in 56:52-55 make eating, filling, and repeated drinking one uninterrupted process; 56:56 deictically labels the whole process as their nuzul.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compulsory swallowing, capacity-filling, hot drink, unrelieved thirst, guest-provision, and recompense; I infer a self-renewing anti-hospitality mechanism in which attempted relief drives further intake. The alternative is a linear list of distinct torments.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes one aversive meal.
changed_reading.after: It opens an anti-banquet with no satiety and no relief: the body becomes full while its need to drink is actively maintained.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the nonbotanical dispute branch of ش ج ر and the social-corruption branch of eating. It remains anchored in two focus roots and gains support from companionship, enclosure, and gathering in the local sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a social-material overlay, not as a replacement lexical meaning for the tree.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَجَرٍ can image tangled dispute, while ءَاكِلُونَ can image corruption moving among people; both remain inside the literal eating syntax.

activation_trace.role: Interwoven quarrel and mixed speech turn the tree into a possible material image of collective conflict.
Corruption carried between people supplies a social mode of eating that the literal ingestion can internalize.
Forced swallowing makes internalization of the entangled relation concrete.
Companionship and sustained attachment identify the addressed people as a relation-bound collective.
Enclosure from all sides gives the collective relation a containing structure.
Regathering what was dispersed brings the relation-bound collective to one site of ingestion.

changed_reading.before: Separate condemned individuals eat from the same hostile tree.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the gathered collective is made to internalize the tangled and corrupting relation that helped constitute it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ك ل ل mapping for the focus root. The supplied split mapping and the immediate filling of the belly keep it inspectable, but downstream prose should mark it as a mapped sound/root echo rather than claim that ءَاكِلُونَ lexically means burden or totality.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus ء ك ل not only to its ordinary eating root but also to ك ل ل branches of burden and encompassing totality.

activation_trace.role: Dependence and burdensome weight recast compulsory eating as a load imposed on the eater.
Encompassing all parts supplies a totalizing scope to the imposed load.
Forced swallowing attaches that totalizing burden to the actual intake event.
Filling until container and contents correspond gives the totalizing echo a bodily realization.
The belly as interior identifies the bounded container wholly occupied by the burden.

changed_reading.before: Eating is an action performed by the condemned.
changed_reading.after: As a contained mapped echo, eating becomes an imposed load that expands until it occupies the eater's whole interior.

strongest_changes: The resurrection sequence makes eating an enacted proof of reassembled, vulnerable embodiment.
The post-focus sequence turns a meal into self-renewing anti-hospitality: full belly, hot drink, and thirst without closure.
The preceding heat field strengthens the focus-only possibility that humans ingest what fire eats and become an interior combustion site.
summary.what_was_special: The focus branches made mouth, throat, tree-yield, fuel, and provision one reversible intake system; the local context then exposed that system as bodily proof, appetite-reversal, and punitive hospitality rather than a static exotic food image.
remaining_uncertainties: The combustion model depends on extending the fire-eating branch directionally from environment to interior body.
The appetite-reciprocity model infers a mirrored consequence from luxury and persistence; the packet does not explicitly state that causal symmetry.
The collective-conflict and ك ل ل readings are deliberately contained branch-distant overlays.
